sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Itt (here) combines with az/a + noun to introduce something, similar to English 'here's the...'.

items.spanish: Jó napot kívánok! Itt az étlap.

items.english: I'd like sugar and milk too.

sections.content: Jó napot kívánok is a more formal greeting than szia — use it with waiters, shopkeepers, and strangers.
